judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong message and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionSummaryFrame` / `SessionListMessage` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationSummary` / `ConversationListMessage`). It completely omitted the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, directly violating the ticket by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor` instead of an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame. Validation also allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of restricting `limit` to integers 1–200 as specified. Additionally, `StoreCannotList`, updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` were all missed, and `.lore/dod.md` was left in the diff.
